coverageRationale.zh: 把 GM/T 0128-2023 的 UDP 改造写成可复述的协议链：显式 epoch/seq 记录头、Cookie 抗 DoS、握手分片字段、预主密钥→主密钥→工作密钥三级派生；明确防重放窗口与 PKI 边界。
coverageRationale.en: Turns GM/T 0128-2023 into a reproducible protocol chain: explicit epoch/seq record header, cookie anti-DoS, handshake fragment fields and pre-master→master→working-key derivation, with replay-window and PKI boundaries.

zh.principle: **标准**：数据报传输层密码协议规范（Specification of Datagram Transport Layer Cryptography Protocol）。GM/T 0128-2023 定义 DTLCP：在 TLCP 的记录层、握手协议族和密钥计算之上，针对 UDP 的丢包、乱序、重复与放大攻击做改造。记录头增加 epoch 与 48 位 seq_num，握手消息增加 message_seq、fragment_offset、fragment_length；大消息按路径 MTU 分片，接收端重组。
zh.why: UDP 没有 TCP 的连接状态与字节流语义，不能直接套用 TLS 记录层。Cookie 让服务端在消耗状态前验证源地址；显式序号让接收端在无连接状态下仍能做重放判断。epoch 在换密钥时递增，把“旧密钥下的序号”和“新密钥下的序号”分开，避免跨密钥重放。
zh.used: 握手先 ClientHello，服务端回 HelloVerifyRequest 带 cookie，客户端带 cookie 重发；随后协商参数、交换证书、完成 ClientKeyExchange 与 Finished。密钥材料按预主密钥→主密钥→工作密钥三级派生；工作密钥拆成客户端/服务端加密键、完整性键和 IV，记录层按方向选键。
zh.broken: 常见错误是把 DTLCP 当“TLCP over UDP”：DTLCP 的记录层有显式序号、分片与重组，和 TLS 的隐式序号/字节流不同。Cookie 只防伪造源和放大，不证明身份；防重放窗口大小也不是标准固定值。证书、信任链、吊销与 Finished 仍要按 PKI 与协议完成。### 形式模型

GM/T 0128-2023 于 2023-12-04 发布、2024-06-01 实施，正文 18 页；全国标准信息公共服务平台记为 CCS L80、ICS 35.030，引用 GM/Z 4001 与 GB/T 38636-2020。它补齐了国密协议栈在 UDP 数据报场景的空白：TLCP 解决面向连接的传输层，DTLCP 解决数据报传输层。

公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。

en.principle: **Standard**: Specification of Datagram Transport Layer Cryptography Protocol (数据报传输层密码协议规范). GM/T 0128-2023 defines DTLCP: it adapts the TLCP record layer, handshake family and key calculation to UDP loss, reordering, duplication and amplification attacks. The record header adds epoch and a 48-bit seq_num; handshake messages add message_seq, fragment_offset and fragment_length. Large messages are fragmented to path MTU and reassembled by the receiver.
en.why:
UDP has no TCP connection state or byte-stream semantics, so TLS record rules cannot be copied directly. Cookies let the server validate the source before spending state; explicit sequence numbers let the receiver make replay decisions without a connection.

Epoch increments on key change, separating “sequence under the old key” from “sequence under the new key” and preventing cross-key replay.
en.used:
The handshake starts with ClientHello; the server returns HelloVerifyRequest with a cookie, and the client resends with the cookie. Parameters, certificates, ClientKeyExchange and Finished follow.

Key material derives in three levels: pre-master → master → working keys. Working keys split into client/server encryption, integrity and IV keys, selected by direction at the record layer.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
A common error is treating DTLCP as “TLCP over UDP”: DTLCP records carry explicit sequence numbers, fragmentation and reassembly, unlike TLS implicit sequence numbers and byte streams.

Cookies stop spoofed sources and amplification, not identity; replay-window size is not a fixed standard value. Certificates, trust chains, revocation and Finished still follow PKI and protocol rules.

en.history:
GM/T 0128-2023 was published on 2023-12-04 and took effect on 2024-06-01; it has 18 pages. The national standards platform records CCS L80 and ICS 35.030, and it references GM/Z 4001 and GB/T 38636-2020.

It fills the UDP datagram gap in the Chinese cryptographic protocol stack: TLCP covers connection-oriented transport, DTLCP covers datagram transport.
